title: Getting things done
body:
Reminders is a great fit for anyone using the GTD methodology. I have been managing around 500 items synced across my ipad, iphone and macbook.

Dragging and dropping from emails, notes, etc. directly to reminders is a great feature to quickly get back to context when working on reminders. if you drop an email from Mail into Reminders, you can then access that email from any of your devices by just clicking on the Reminder.

There are many small things like the above drag & drag of emails that make Reminders a great app for tasks and getting things done.
